$comment: Marker for the github-project-release-manager skill. Presence => Operational mode; do not re-run setup analysis.

project.title: repo-governor
project.status_snapshot: 15 Done, 6 Backlog (2026-08-17). Reconciled against issue state: 0 drift across 21 items.
project.write_scope_acquired: 2026-08-17 — token now carries 'project'; manual field edits work. Note the refresh REPLACED read:project rather than adding to it.

board.reason: Linked by the maintainer on 2026-08-17, overriding the computed recommendation of 'none'. The override is correct and the score is not wrong: it measures COORDINATION need — contributors, open items, activity — and coordination need genuinely is low for a solo repository. What it does not measure is TRACKING need. This repository carries 19 tracked items across three distinct categories (gate conditions, thesis risks, architecture questions) with real dependencies between them, and that is what the board is for. Two different needs; the score only sees one.
board.revisit_when: board sits empty with no open issues for an extended period, or the maintainer asks to reconsider

release.reason: Gate work is now tracked under milestone RG-SIM-ONBOARDING-v0.1 (0/7). Still no shippable artifact, so no tags, CHANGELOG, or release automation yet.
release.revisit_when: A release is now unblocked on licensing but still blocked on ADR status. Revisit when the ADRs are moved from Proposed to Accepted.
release.milestone_scope: Expanded 2026-08-17 from 7 gate conditions to 10. Rule: an issue belongs in RG-SIM-ONBOARDING-v0.1 if it blocks IMPLEMENTATION_READY. #15/#17/#18 block gate conditions and were added; #1/#2/#16 are product-viability and positioning questions and were kept out.
release.milestone_progress: RG-THESIS-v0.2 2/2 — 21 (engine resolves providers through the manifest) and 19 (roadmap of record moved to GitHub).
release.implementation_gate: MET 2026-08-17. RG-SIM-ONBOARDING-v0.1 passes. Note: met against 17 ADRs that are all still Proposed.
release.shippable_artifact: Now exists: 12 adapters, 7 engine modules, 6 conformance suites, SKILL.md. Release decision stays 'milestone' — no version cut yet, and commits are not conventional, so any version recommendation is judgment-based rather than derivable.
release.version_recommendation: v0.1.0, judgment-based. 0 feat / 0 fix / 0 breaking across 42 commits because this repository does not use conventional commits, so the count is not evidence of a patch release — it is evidence the heuristic does not apply here.
release.release_blocker: All 22 ADRs are still Proposed. Tagging would publish an architecture nothing has accepted. Licensing is no longer a blocker: Apache-2.0 applied 2026-08-17 and detected by GitHub.
release.license: Apache-2.0, applied 2026-08-17. Chosen for the patent grant and contribution terms because ADR-003's adapter protocol invites third-party adapters. Ownership (section 68, Tosin Open Source) was decided separately and is recorded in NOTICE.

open_work.$comment: Post-milestone. None of these block anything; all are open questions or backlog.

issues.20: manifest does not bound what the host could supply; five-layer authority taxonomy recorded
issues.5: skill activation reliability across hosts — governance logic is not governance enforcement
issues.2: ScopeEnvelope thinness — measured: ALWAYS thin on real trackers, not merely often
issues.1: cross-provider normalization — the thesis question; Layer 2 has never run on two LIVE providers

open_work.note: All six deliberately unmilestoned, and therefore NOT_ADMITTED under the declared admission signal. That is the honest reading: open questions are not admitted work. There is no v0.3 milestone and creating one would invent a scope nobody has decided.

governance_self_binding.$comment: This repository is now governed by its own engine off GitHub issues, not off a local file. Recorded because the previous arrangement was a section 54 failure condition that went unnoticed for 40 commits (ADR-022).
governance_self_binding.consequence: An issue with no milestone reads NOT_ADMITTED and blocks. Correct for the deferrals (6, 14) and for the open questions (1, 2, 5, 20), which are not admitted work.
